items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: The interviewee discusses Chris Kelley's career and playing style in the third person ('Chris Kelly, he came here and he got organized...') and does not claim to have played with, met, or collaborated with him personally.

ctx.x: Oh, they were brothers. What did Ben play?

I think Ben used to play alto. And Chris was on the cornet? Yeah. About how big a band was it? Oh, it was ten to twelve men's, you know. And you said they played on Sunday, was there any place to parade around there much? Well they would just walk around, up and down the road, you know. And when the train would pass during the Sunday evening, well they would go and meet the train, you see? Oh yeah. And the train would pass there and the people that was on there would enjoy listening to them playing, you see? Oh…
Oh yeah, I see. Yeah. Did you ever have any funerals down there that the band would play for?
